steps.title: Step 2

recipes.name: Arepa
recipes.notes: Source: TheMealDB id 53439. Free for commercial use. https://www.themealdb.com/

steps.title: Step 1
steps.instruction: Put the corn flour in a bowl and add the salted water little by little, mixing with the flour until all the water has been used and the flour has become a dough. Let it rest for five minutes. Now, shape the dough into round rolls about 3 inches in diameter and 1/2 inch thick. In a lightly greased skillet, slowly cook the arepas until a crust forms on each side. Now place them into a casserole and bake in the oven at 350 degrees for approximately 20 minutes, until the arepas sound hollow when tapped.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.instruction: To enhance taste: instead of using just water, use chicken or beef broth.

recipes.name: Bajan Salt Bread Recipe
recipes.notes: Source: TheMealDB id 53456. Free for commercial use. https://www.themealdb.com/

steps.title: Step 1
steps.instruction: Sift half the flour, mix with salt and yeast in a large mixing bowl, and slowly add warm water until the mixture forms a stiff dough. Add more sifted flour until you have a stiff enough dough to knead.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.instruction: Lightly flour the work surface, knead the dough for 10 minutes until it is smooth and elastic, and then place it in a greased bowl. Now place the bowl warmly for 40-50 minutes until it has doubled. You know the dough is ready when you poke a finger, and the indentation remains.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.instruction: Preheat oven to 425 degrees F or 220 degrees C.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.instruction: Now divide the dough into 12 equal portions, roll each into a fist size ball, and place on a greased baking sheet. Now place in a warm place again for a further 40 minutes or again until the dough has doubled in size.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.instruction: Now place in the oven’s center and bake for 25-30 minutes until golden brown rolls sound hollow when tapped.

recipes.name: Bajan Sweet Bread
recipes.notes: Source: TheMealDB id 53460. Free for commercial use. https://www.themealdb.com/

steps.title: Step 1
steps.instruction: Add all the flour, baking powder, and salt to a large mixing bowl.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.instruction: Melt the butter in a saucepan.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.instruction: Mix the coconut and most of the sugar in another bowl – leave some back to cover the loaves later, raisins, egg, milk, almond essence, vanilla essence, and melted butter.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.instruction: Mix well until you have a creamy paste.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.instruction: Add this to the bowl with the flour, baking powder, and salt. Mix until you form a stiff dough.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.instruction: Now divide the mixture between the baking tins.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.instruction: Now boil the water.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.instruction: Mix two tablespoons of sugar with some hot water and brush the top of each loaf.

steps.title: Step 9
steps.instruction: Bake in the center of the oven for 1 hour.

steps.title: Step 10
steps.instruction: Leave to cool in tins before serving; slice and serve with a fresh pot of tea.

recipes.name: Bolani with Potato Filling
recipes.notes: Source: TheMealDB id 53401. Free for commercial use. https://www.themealdb.com/

steps.title: Step 1
steps.instruction: Put the flour and teaspoon of salt in a mixing bowl. Slowly adding as much water as is required. Mix to form a stiff dough.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.instruction: Place the dough on a clean work surface and knead for about 5-10 minutes until the dough is elastic, smooth and shiny. Form the dough into a ball, cover with a damp cloth and set aside for at least half an hour.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.instruction: Peel and wash the potatoes and boil them in salted water until soft. Drain off the water and mash thoroughly. Add the spring onions, salt and black pepper.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.instruction: Divide the dough into 3 or 4 balls. Roll out each ball as thinly as possible on a lightly floured surface (the thickness should be no more than 1.5mm - if the dough is too thick the Bolani will be tough)

steps.title: Step 5
steps.instruction: Take a round cutter of 13-15cm (I often use a pan lid or tid lid), and cut as many rounds as possible. On each round spread 1-2 tablespoons of the mashed potato. Moisten the edges of the dough, fold over and seal shut.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.instruction: The Bolani should be spread out on a lightly floured surface until ready to fry. Heat enough vegetable oil in a frying-pan and shallow fry one or two Bolani at a time, browning on both sides.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.instruction: Make sure to keep the fried Bolani warm until all are finished, and serve straight away.

recipes.name: Brazilian cheese bread (pão de queijo)

steps.instruction: Heat the milk, butter and salt in a medium saucepan and bring to a boil. Remove from the heat and add the tapioca flour. Stir vigorously, then leave to cool a little.

Beat the eggs in one at a time, waiting until each is completely incorporated before adding the next. When the dough is glossy and mixed, add the parmesan. Beat again until mixed.

steps.instruction: Spoon the dough onto the baking sheet in 1 tbsp balls, 5cm apart. Bake for 30 mins until crisp and golden. Remove from the oven and eat while still warm.

recipes.name: Breadfruit in Butter Sauce
recipes.notes: Source: TheMealDB id 53458. Free for commercial use. https://www.themealdb.com/

steps.title: Step 1
steps.instruction: Cut the breadfruit, remove the seeds in the core, and peel. Boil in salted water with a little onion and oil, over high heat until tender and drain.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.instruction: Meanwhile, melt the butter in a frying pan and lightly brown the onion rings. Add the garlic, tomatoes, parsley, lime juice, salt, and pepper. Continue to sauté for a couple of minutes. Add the water, bring to the boil and simmer for 5-10 minutes.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.instruction: Slice the cooled breadfruit and place it in a serving dish. Pour the butter sauce over the breadfruit.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.instruction: Garnish with chopped fresh parsley.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.instruction: Serves 4

recipes.name: Breadfruit Tacos
recipes.notes: Source: TheMealDB id 53562. Free for commercial use. https://www.themealdb.com/

steps.title: Step 1
steps.instruction: Place a large pot of water to boil, add breadfruit, and let it cook for around 30 minutes

steps.title: Step 2
steps.instruction: Remove breadfruit from pot and let it cool for a few minutes

steps.title: Step 3
steps.instruction: Hold the breadfruit firmly and using a large sharp knife slice into thin rounds

steps.title: Step 4
steps.instruction: Slice as many as you need

steps.title: Step 5
steps.instruction: Then cut off skin and core (You may leave the core on if you like)

steps.title: Step 6
steps.instruction: Gently fold to shape like a taco shell, use two toothpicks to hold it in place.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.instruction: Place on a large plate or tray and repeat this process for all breadfruit slices

steps.title: Step 8
steps.instruction: Heat oil for deep frying, using a pair of tongs submerge breadfruit slices in pan,

steps.title: Step 9
steps.instruction: You can guide slices with tongs if you need to

steps.title: Step 10
steps.instruction: You can leave the small toothpicks in the taco shells and remove them after they're cooked. Or, you can do like I did. If your'e using larger toothpicks, you may need to remove them safely. Be very careful as you need to adjust it in the hot oil.

steps.title: Step 11
steps.instruction: Remove when golden brown

steps.title: Step 12
steps.instruction: Set over tissue paper

steps.title: Step 13
steps.instruction: Repeat this for the rest of the shells

steps.title: Step 14
steps.instruction: Stuff the shell with your favorite filling. I chose codfish/ salt fish

recipes.name: Bulgarian Green Salad

steps.title: Step 2

steps.title: Step 4
steps.instruction: Season with salt and gently toss to combine.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.instruction: Top with sliced hard-boiled eggs, olives, dill and (or) parsley if using and serve immediately.

recipes.name: Cayman Style Potato Salad
recipes.notes: Source: TheMealDB id 53507. Free for commercial use. https://www.themealdb.com/

steps.title: Step 1
steps.instruction: Peel and cut potatoes in cubes, boil in salted water until tender.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.instruction: Chop peppers and onion and set aside.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.instruction: Mix together mayonnaise, mustard, sugar and black pepper and set aside.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.instruction: Drain potatoes once tender and place in large mixing bowl.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.instruction: Add remaining ingredients and mix well.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.instruction: The salad may be served warm, but is normally served after it has been refrigerated for 2 to 3 hours.

recipes.name: Cheese Sticks
recipes.notes: Source: TheMealDB id 53442. Free for commercial use. https://www.themealdb.com/

steps.title: Step 1
steps.instruction: Cut the cheese and long strips and place in your fridge to prevent it becoming soft. Mix flour, butter and egg in a bowl, and add sugar, salt and olive oil to taste into the mix. Then gradually add milk and knead well for a suitable consistency.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.instruction: Stretch out the dough with a rolling pin and cut into long strips (2 to 3 cm) and then roll the strips of dough around the cheese strips forming a spiral. Make sure the dough covers the cheese fully so that it doesn't melt out while frying. Roll the cheese & dough strips through flour to prevent them from sticking while frying. Heat oil in a frying pan until hot before placing the cheese sticks, and fry until golden in color.

recipes.name: Chilean Dobladitas
recipes.notes: Source: TheMealDB id 53516. Free for commercial use. https://www.themealdb.com/

steps.title: Step 1
steps.instruction: Preheat the oven to 450 degrees F (230 degrees C). Grease a baking sheet.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.instruction: Whisk flour, 1 cup melted butter, milk, baking powder, and salt together in a bowl until begins to pull together. Turn dough out onto a lightly floured surface; knead until smooth and elastic.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.instruction: Roll dough out to ⅛-inch thickness; cut into 8-inch circles. Brush circles with remaining 3 tablespoons melted butter. Fold each circle in half, then fold in half again to form triangles. Press firmly to seal the layers; place on the prepared baking sheet.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.instruction: Bake in the preheated oven until golden brown, about 15 minutes. Serve warm

recipes.name: Chilean-Style Sopaipillas
recipes.notes: Source: TheMealDB id 53513. Free for commercial use. https://www.themealdb.com/

steps.title: Step 1
steps.instruction: Peel, seed, and cut zapallo into chunks. Place in a saucepan, cover with water, and bring to a boil over medium-high heat. Cook until zapallo is soft and easily pierced with a fork, 15 to 20 minutes. Drain and allow to cool slightly.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.instruction: Mix flour, baking soda, and salt together in a mixing bowl, and set aside. Stir together squash and melted butter. Stir the flour mixture into the butter mixture until blended. Turn the dough out onto a lightly floured surface and knead until soft and satiny, adding a little more flour if necessary. Cover dough with a towel and allow to rest 15 minutes.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.instruction: Roll out the dough to 1/8-inch thick, and cut into 3-inch diameter circles. Poke each circle a few times with a fork to make holes and prevent rising.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.instruction: Pour oil into a large, deep skillet and heat over medium-high heat until hot, 385 degrees F (195 degrees C). Place several of the dough circles into hot oil; cook until lightly browned, 3 to 4 minutes. Drain on paper towels. Cook remainder of dough circles in batches.

recipes.name: Classic Potato Salad
recipes.notes: Source: TheMealDB id 53555. Free for commercial use. https://www.themealdb.com/

steps.title: Step 1
steps.instruction: Boil potatoes in lightly salted water for 10 to 12 minutes. Drain water when a potato speared with a fork and lifted out of the water easily glides off the fork and falls back into the pot. Let potatoes stand and cool.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.instruction: Break off and discard the stringy ends of the asparagus spears, then chop into small pieces. You can pour boiling water over the chopped asparagus and let it soak for 2 minutes if you prefer a less raw taste.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.instruction: Finely chop chives, red onion and radish.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.instruction: Stir the dressing ingredients together and season with salt and pepper.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.instruction: Reserve some of the chives for garnish and combine the rest of the vegetables with the dressing.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.instruction: Season with salt and pepper, garnish with chives and serve as a side dish.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.instruction: Tip

steps.title: Step 8
steps.instruction: When in season, you can add fresh peas to this potato salad

recipes.name: Colombian Buñuelos Recipe
recipes.notes: Source: TheMealDB id 53523. Free for commercial use. https://www.themealdb.com/

steps.title: Step 1
steps.instruction: Place all the ingredients, except the oil in a medium bowl and mix well using your hands until soft and smooth dough is obtained.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.instruction: Form small balls using your hands.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.instruction: In a deep pot, heat the vegetable oil to 300°F (Warm, not very hot). Carefully drop the balls in the warm oil and fry for about 3 to 4 minutes or until gilden brown.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.instruction: Remove from the oil and drain on a plate lined with paper towels. Serve.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.instruction: Frying Colombian buñuelos using the right temperature is very important. The oil can't be very hot or very cold. Be sure the oil is heated to 300 to 320 grades F.

recipes.name: Corn on the cob with lime, green chilli and coconut butter
recipes.notes: Source: TheMealDB id 53431. Free for commercial use. https://www.themealdb.com/

steps.title: Step 1
steps.instruction: Bring the stock to a rolling boil in a big, deep pan. Slip in the cobs, leave to cook for about five minutes, then turn off the heat and leave the corn to sit in the stock as it cools.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.instruction: Put a heavy-based dry frying pan on a high heat and, once hot, lay the drained corn in the pan and char for a couple of minutes on each side – you’ll probably need to cook them two or three at a time, so you don’t overcrowd the pan. Put the coconut milk, lime juice and chillies in a small saucepan, season lightly, then bring up to a gentle simmer. Stir in the butter, turn off the heat and set aside.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.instruction: For the topping, toast the coconut flakes in a hot dry frying pan – coconut burns very easily, so keep them moving and keep your eye on them. As soon as the coconut has a golden, burnished, toasted colour, tip it into a bowl, leave to cool, then mix with the crispy shallots and herbs, and season to taste.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.instruction: To serve, spoon some of the coconut milk mixture over each cob, sprinkle with the toasted coconut mix and lime zest, and tuck in.

recipes.name: Curried Spinach from Botswana
recipes.notes: Source: TheMealDB id 53473. Free for commercial use. https://www.themealdb.com/

steps.title: Step 1
steps.instruction: Heat the oil in a skillet over medium heat. When hot, add the diced onion and cook until lightly browned.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.instruction: Add the curry powder and salt to taste and toast for a few seconds.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.instruction: Add the chopped tomatoes and the water, stir well, and cook until the tomatoes begin to break down, 5-7 minutes.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.instruction: Add in the chopped (or baby) spinach and cook for 7-10 minutes more, until soft and wilted.

recipes.name: Danish Rye Bread
recipes.notes: Source: TheMealDB id 53556. Free for commercial use. https://www.themealdb.com/

steps.title: Step 1
steps.instruction: Combine rye grain and water in a saucepan and bring to a boil. Cover and simmer for 2 to 3 minutes.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.instruction: Transfer the boiled rye grain to a mixing bowl and combine with beer, buttermilk and salt.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.instruction: Dissolve the fresh yeast in this mixture and then add the seeds.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.instruction: Add all-purpose flour and rye flour, and knead for about 10 minutes. You can also use a kitchen mixer to knead the dough.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.instruction: Transfer the dough to an oiled loaf pan (2.5 l) and smooth out with a spatula.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.instruction: Poke holes in the surface with a fork and cover loaf pan with plastic wrap. Let the dough rise for 1½ hours at room temperature, or for 24 hours in the refrigerator.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.instruction: Pre-heat oven to 200°C / 392℉ (175°C / 347℉ on fan setting) and bake bread on the bottom rack for about 75 minutes. Test to make sure dry in centre, or if using an oven thermometer, set it to turn off when centre reaches 98°C / 208℉

steps.title: Step 8
steps.instruction: Allow the bread to cool completely before slicing.

steps.title: Step 9
steps.instruction: TIP

steps.title: Step 10
steps.instruction: If you refrigerate the dough while rising, let it stand at room temperature for 1 hour before baking.

recipes.name: Dolma Japrak Stuffed Vine Leaves
recipes.notes: Source: TheMealDB id 53411. Free for commercial use. https://www.themealdb.com/

steps.title: Step 2
steps.instruction: Preperation

steps.title: Step 3
steps.instruction: Add the onions to a saute pan and fry for 5 minutes in olive oil until the onions start to brown.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.instruction: Turn off the heat and add the meat, rice, pepper, paprika, dried vegetable stock, parsley and basil. Mix all the ingredients together.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.instruction: Carefully unwrap the vine leaves. Place one vine leaf on your hand with the base on the bottom of your palm and the point pointing towards the top. Add a second vine leaf with the point pointing downwards and base of the leaf at the top of your fingers. there should be a good overlap. You can do this on a flat surface if preferred.

steps.title: Step 9
steps.instruction: Place a spoonful of the meat and rice mixture in the middle of the leaves. Fold the bottom of the leaf over the mixture, fold in both sides and the roll the leaf upwards sealing in the mixture into a parcel shape.

steps.title: Step 11
steps.instruction: Layer a layer of vine leaves covering the bottom of a deep saucepan and then add the vine leaf parcel on top.

steps.title: Step 13
steps.instruction: Make as many vine leaf parcels as the meat and rice mixture will make adding each one to the saucepan. Pack the parcels side by side util the saucepan is covered, then start another layer on top.

recipes.name: Dominica mastiff bread
recipes.notes: Source: TheMealDB id 53563. Free for commercial use. https://www.themealdb.com/

steps.title: Step 1
steps.instruction: Mix all dry ingredients in a large bowl (sugar, salt and instant yeast)

steps.title: Step 2
steps.instruction: Mix with a large wooden spoon

steps.title: Step 3
steps.instruction: Add shortening or lard and mix

steps.title: Step 4
steps.instruction: Mix thoroughly with your hand

steps.title: Step 5
steps.instruction: Add warm water and mix the dough until stiff

steps.title: Step 6
steps.instruction: Add more flour so that dough doesn't stick

steps.title: Step 7
steps.instruction: You can add dough onto a floured board to make sure that it's properly kneaded

steps.title: Step 8
steps.instruction: Knead for approximately 8-10 minutes

steps.title: Step 9
steps.instruction: Shape dough into a large round shape and cover to rest for 45 minutes

steps.title: Step 10
steps.instruction: Knead dough again on a lightly floured surface (kneading is the most critical part of this recipe process.

steps.title: Step 11
steps.instruction: Shape dough into your desired bread designs and place on a baking sheet or bread pan

steps.title: Step 12
steps.instruction: Let the breads rest for 25 minutes

steps.title: Step 13
steps.instruction: Preheat oven at 375°F

steps.title: Step 14
steps.instruction: Bake until golden brown

recipes.name: Haft Mewa Recipe
recipes.notes: Source: TheMealDB id 53397. Free for commercial use. https://www.themealdb.com/

steps.title: Step 1
steps.instruction: Wash the apricots and both raisins and place in a bowl - cover with cold water to 5cm above the fruit.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.instruction: Put the walnuts, pistachos and almonds in another bowl or pan and add boiling water. Leave to soak, and then peel off all the skins as they soften. This is a fiddly job and make take some time - but it's definitely worth the effort! Throw away the water.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.instruction: Combine the fruits with the nuts and cherries, including the juice they have been soaking in. Add the rose water, cover the mixture and leave in the fridge to rest for two days. When you leave the mix, the juice will become sweeter and syrupy, giving the dish a really unique consistency.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.instruction: To serve, spoon the fruit, nuts and juice into individual bowls or cups, and enjoy!

recipes.name: Hveder - Danish Wheat Buns
recipes.notes: Source: TheMealDB id 53552. Free for commercial use. https://www.themealdb.com/

steps.title: Step 1
steps.instruction: Heat milk in a saucepan until warm to the touch (25°C / 77℉). Transfer milk to a mixing bowl and dissolve the yeast in the milk.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.instruction: Add the remaining ingredients except for the butter and knead thoroughly. Use a kitchen mixer to knead the dough if you have one.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.instruction: Cut the butter into cubes and add to the dough. Knead for 5 to 10 minutes until the dough is elastic and smooth.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.instruction: Cover the dough and let rise in a warm place for 45 minutes.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.instruction: Transfer the dough to a counter sprinkled with flour and divide into 10-12 pieces of equal size. Roll each piece into a round bun and arrange the buns close to each other on a lined roasting pan or oven-proof dish (approximately 20 x 30 cm). Cover the buns and let rise for approximately 1 hour until they double in size.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.instruction: Heat the oven to 180°C / 356℉ on fan setting.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.instruction: Beat the egg in a small bowl and brush the tops of the buns with egg. Bake on the middle oven rack for 14 to 16 minutes until the buns develop a nice golden surface. Serve warm or toasted with butter.

recipes.name: Jajek
recipes.notes: Source: TheMealDB id 53436. Free for commercial use. https://www.themealdb.com/

steps.title: Step 1
steps.instruction: Place yogurt, water, garlic and salt in food processor and process for a few seconds. Transfer to a bowl and mix with mint and cucumber.  Best served chilled for a few hours.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.instruction: When serving, add a few ice cubes to add additional refreshment!  Makes about four servings.

recipes.name: Keto Banitsa
recipes.notes: Source: TheMealDB id 53494. Free for commercial use. https://www.themealdb.com/

steps.title: Step 1
steps.instruction: Preheat oven to 360 F (180 C)

steps.title: Step 2
steps.instruction: Beat eggs in a bowl, using a whisk ( no mixer needed).

steps.title: Step 3
steps.instruction: Slowly add the melted butter, whisking to incorporate.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.instruction: Add the cheeses (mozzarella, feta and cream cheese), stir to combine. Then add the baking powder and whisk.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.instruction: Grease a 8×8 -inch square baking dish with butter and pour the mixture inside. Top with sesame seeds (optional).

steps.title: Step 6
steps.instruction: Bake for 20 minutes, until golden.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.instruction: Let it cool for 5-10 minutes inside the pan, then cut into pieces and serve.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.instruction: Keep in the fridge for up to 3 days.

recipes.name: Koulenje
recipes.notes: Source: TheMealDB id 53434. Free for commercial use. https://www.themealdb.com/

steps.title: Step 1
steps.instruction: Sift flour, baking powder, salt, and sugar together. In a separate bowl, beat 6 eggs, then blend in the butter and milk.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.instruction: Sprinkle one tablespoon of sev dzandig (black seeds) and all the mahleb on top of the dry ingredients. Make a hole in the center of the dry ingredients and pour the wet ingredients in all at once, mixing with a few strokes until the dough can be turned out onto a floured board. Add more flour if necessary; it shouldn't be too sticky.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.instruction: Knead the mixture gently, just a few times, and then roll it out until it is ½" thick. Cut it into diamond shapes, circles, or long strips which can be rolled and braided into loaves. Prick each piece several times with a fork.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.instruction: Beat the seventh egg with additional sev dzandig (black seeds) added. Brush each piece of koulenje with this glaze and place on cookie sheet covered with baking parchment.

steps.title: Step 5

recipes.name: Num Ansom – Sticky Rice Cake
recipes.notes: Source: TheMealDB id 53500. Free for commercial use. https://www.themealdb.com/

steps.title: Step 1
steps.instruction: 1. Drain the soaked glutinous rice thoroughly in a fine-mesh strainer.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.instruction: 2. In a medium bowl, combine the coconut milk, palm sugar, and salt, stirring until the sugar dissolves completely.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.instruction: 3. Add the drained rice to the coconut milk mixture, mixing gently to coat every grain evenly. Let it sit for 15 minutes to absorb the liquid.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.instruction: 4. Prepare a steamer by filling the bottom pot with 2 inches of water and bringing it to a boil over high heat.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.instruction: 5. Lay a banana leaf square flat on your work surface, shiny side up. Spoon ¼ cup of the rice mixture into the center, spreading it into a 4-inch rectangle.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.instruction: 6. Place 2 tablespoons of mung bean paste in a line down the middle of the rice rectangle.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.instruction: 7. Fold the banana leaf over the filling lengthwise, then fold in the sides to create a tight parcel. Tip: Press firmly to compact the rice, which helps it hold its shape during steaming.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.instruction: 8. Secure the parcel with kitchen twine, tying it firmly but not too tight to allow for expansion.

steps.title: Step 9
steps.instruction: 9. Repeat steps 5–8 with the remaining ingredients to make 8 parcels total.

steps.title: Step 10
steps.instruction: 10. Arrange the parcels in a single layer in the steamer basket, leaving small gaps between them for steam circulation.

steps.title: Step 11
steps.instruction: 11. Cover the steamer and steam over medium heat for 90 minutes, checking halfway to ensure the water hasn’t boiled dry—add more hot water if needed. Tip: The parcels are done when the banana leaves turn a deep green and the rice feels firm to the touch.

steps.title: Step 12
steps.instruction: 12. Carefully remove the parcels from the steamer and let them cool for 20 minutes before unwrapping. Tip: Cooling sets the texture, making slicing cleaner.

steps.title: Step 13
steps.instruction: 13. Unwrap the banana leaves and slice each parcel into 1-inch thick rounds for serving.

recipes.name: Num E (Sticky Rice Balls in Sugar Syrup and Coconut Cream)
recipes.notes: Source: TheMealDB id 53422. Free for commercial use. https://www.themealdb.com/

steps.title: Step 1
steps.instruction: Place coconut cream in a small pot over low heat. Cut 3 pandan leaves into large strips and add to the pot with brown sugar, salt, and ginger. Bring to a boil, then cook 2 more minutes. Turn off the heat, remove the pandan leaves, and let cool.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.instruction: Chop the remaining 4 pandan leaves, blend with ¼ cup water until very green, then strain well. In a bowl, place 200 g sticky rice flour, add a little pandan liquid, and knead until smooth.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.instruction: Peel and chop beetroot, blend with ¼ cup water until red, then strain well. In a bowl, place 200 g sticky rice flour, add a little beetroot liquid, and knead until smooth.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.instruction: Bring 3 litres of water to a boil in a medium–large pot. Divide each dough into small pieces, roll into balls about ⅓ the size of a ping pong ball, then drop into boiling water. When they float, remove and place them into fresh, icy water to keep them separate.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.instruction: Drain well, then place the mixed colored balls into the cooled coconut sugar syrup and stir. Serve in small bowls (add longan and shredded coconut as desired).

steps.title: Step 6
steps.instruction: Add the coloring liquids gradually—each flour absorbs differently. You want a dough that’s smooth and pliable, not sticky.

recipes.name: Tendir Choreyi (Tandoori Bread)
recipes.notes: Source: TheMealDB id 53448. Free for commercial use. https://www.themealdb.com/

steps.title: Step 1
steps.instruction: First a quick note about tandoori bread (or tandoori anything, really). The name comes from the clay oven, or "tandoor" that it is traditionally cooked in, and you will never be able to duplicate the flavor of any tandoori recipe without one of those ovens, no matter how hard you try. Now, a tandoor oven is actually a part of my dream kitchen (I love naan bread and tandoori chicken) but I don't have one in my current kitchen, so this bread just goes in a plain oven, which makes it not very authentic. However, this is how an Azerbaijani stranded in the US would make a tandoori bread, so I guess I don't feel too bad about including it in my meal.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.instruction: The ingredients for this bread are roughly similar to the ingredients for a basic french bread, but the shape is different and it is topped with poppy seeds which actually makes it quite beautiful in appearance. In fact this bread is quite possibly the most beautiful thing I've ever baked (my cakes certainly don't fall into that category).

steps.title: Step 3
steps.instruction: So as always I used my bread machine, but this time I didn't proof the yeast first. I just put it in the little yeast dispenser at the top of my machine, then added the water, flour and salt to the bucket. I put it on the dough cycle and then went and picked my kids up from school.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.instruction: This bread uses very basic ingredients, including bread flour and salt.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.instruction: If you want to do it the old-fashioned way:

steps.title: Step 6
steps.instruction: Mix the yeast with the water and let stand for a few minutes. Then sift the flour with the salt into a large bowl. Gradually add the water and yeast and mix with your hand until the dough forms a ball.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.instruction: Turn out onto a lightly floured surface. Knead the dough for 8 to 10 minutes, or until it is smooth. Put it in a large bowl and cover, then let it rise in a warm spot until doubled (this typically takes 1 to 1 1/2 hours).

steps.title: Step 8
steps.instruction: The dough after it has risen.

steps.title: Step 9
steps.instruction: Punch down and turn out onto a lightly floured surface. Stretch the dough until it is an oblong shape, then with a rolling pin roll it until it is about 1/2 inch thick. Transfer to a greased or non-stick baking sheet and let stand for another 15 minutes.

steps.title: Step 10
steps.instruction: After stretching and rolling, your dough should be roughly this shape.

steps.title: Step 11
steps.instruction: Cut crosshatches in the top of the dough, about four in either direction. Brush with the beaten egg yolk (I mixed mine with a little bit of water to make it easier to work with) and sprinkle with poppy seeds.

steps.title: Step 12
steps.instruction: Crosshatches, egg wash and poppy seeds give this bread its distinctive look.

steps.title: Step 13
steps.instruction: Bake in a preheated oven at about 400 degrees for 20 to 25 minutes, until golden on top
